name: posthog
description: :hedgehog: PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all from Slack, web, desktop, or the MCP.

latest_release.name: desktop-v0.61.1039
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat(canvas): turn off canvas authoring in the web app by @GeneralistDev in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/133376
* fix(desktop): retain warm runs across permission changes by @tatoalo in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/133591
* fix(desktop): bound warm sandboxes to composer drafts by @tatoalo in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/133584
* chore(deps): Update posthog-node to 5.73.0 by @posthog-js-upgrader in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/134831
* chore(deps): Update posthog-js to 1.448.0 by @posthog-js-upgrader in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/134344
* fix(desktop): show why a cloud resume was refused by @charlesvien in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/135161
* feat(tasks): push and open gitlab merge requests from the sandbox agent by @dmarticus in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/132309
* feat(tasks): link gitlab projects to tasks behind a credential source by @dmarticus in https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/132287

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/compare/desktop-v0.61.1016...desktop-v0.61.1039
